subject: Mary Kenny Way Subdivision Approval
overview: The board approved a 10-lot subdivision at 541-551 Winthrop Street with extensive conditions and endorsed an approval-not-required plan for George Street. Public hearings for a proposed gas station and a mixed-use redevelopment in Medford Square were continued to September pending further design revisions.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meetings of June 18, 2020, and July 16, 2020.

items.title: 73-79 George Street A&R Plan
items.summary: Approved an approval-not-required plan to create three 5,000-square-foot lots from two existing adjacent parcels.

items.title: 278 Middlesex Avenue (BJ's Gas Station)
items.summary: Tabled the hearing for a self-service fueling station until September 16 to allow the applicant to address board requests regarding dumpster relocation and further review traffic and bike lane improvements.

items.title: Winthrop Estates Definitive Subdivision (Mary Kenny Way)
items.summary: Approved the 10-lot subdivision and site plan at 541-551 Winthrop Street, renamed Mary Kenny Way, including a waiver for curb radii and conditions regarding blasting schedules, pedestrian crosswalks, and cul-de-sac design.

items.title: 30-36 Salem Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the recommendation hearing for a mixed-use residential project because board members found the current design and visual materials insufficient to evaluate the project's impact on the historic district.
